name: 40 fps
description: The game at 40 frames a second (on a 120 Hz screen) instead of 20 or 30, at its normal speed: its logic still steps 15 times a second and every frame is drawn between two steps, as the game does. A frame the device doesn't finish in time shows as soon as it is done. Keep the frame rate capped (Settings: Uncap frame rate off).
author: hakuX
refresh: 120

# Generated by tools/mods/fable_40fps.py from default.xbe (4D5300D1, v1).
# Fable's logic runs at 15 steps a second and it draws between them; its cap
# is the presentation interval: 0x3F700 waits N = ceil(R / fps) vblanks a
# frame (1-3, or at once if late), R the refresh the display object keeps
# ([obj+0x1B8], 60), and its frame period N / R ([obj+0x1C4]) feeds the game
# clock (0x1F36C0). With the vblank at 120 Hz and R doubled where the object
# takes it (0x3F05D, 0x3F503 call the cave at 0x3F881: the mode's refresh
# times 2, then the cvtsi2ss the call replaced), N is 3 for targets of 40 fps
# or less: 40 frames a second, a period of 1/40 s.
[default.xbe]
0x0003F881: CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC -> 8B 44 24 1C 01 C0 F3 0F 2A 85 C0 01 00 00 C3
0x0003F05D: 8B 44 24 18 F3 0F 2A 85 C0 01 00 00 -> E8 1F 08 00 00 90 90 90 90 90 90 90
0x0003F503: 8B 44 24 18 F3 0F 2A 85 C0 01 00 00 -> E8 79 03 00 00 90 90 90 90 90 90 90
